steps.title: Lesson 2: Core Concepts
steps.body: Key Fact: The welfare state (1945): based on Beveridge Report (1942) which identified five 'giant evils': Want, Disease, Ignorance, Squalor, Idleness. Key services: NHS, state education, social security, council housing. | Key Fact: Universal vs means-tested benefits: universal (available to all - NHS, state education) vs means-tested (only for those below a certain income - Universal Credit). Means-testing targets resources but creates the poverty trap. | Key Fact: New Right critique (Murray): welfare creates a 'dependency culture' where people rely on benefits. The 'underclass' is trapped in welfare dependency.
